material: Use case: style-transfer, production UI material texture asset. The supplied wellness phone mockups are STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Study the subtly cloudy satin/suede material INSIDE the small breathing and sleep cards, especially the lavender phone at right and rose phone at left. Generate ONE square 1024x1024 edge-to-edge monochrome material TEXTURE MAP for a native 2D app renderer. Fill the ENTIRE canvas with the material, no card outline, no rounded corners, no margin, no phone, no text, no symbols. Neutral grayscale around RGB 128; restrained tonal variation between roughly gray 85 and gray 175. Ultra fine irregular satin micrograin and soft, diffuse, nonuniform cloudy depth, slightly brighter broad upper-left sheen and darker lower-middle diffuse patches. Surface feels soft translucent smoky satin, with subtle light gathered in uneven soft patches, smooth and premium as the reference. Fine microtexture is visible on close inspection but no discrete dots or particles. STRICTLY NO curved contour lines, stripes, waves, thread patterns, wrinkles, folds, fabric weave, paper fibers, scratches, marble veins, speckles, stars, isolated bright points, hard edges, geometric pattern, objects, vignette border, bevel or decorative shapes. This is a reusable neutral optical material map, not a UI mockup. The application will add the exact palette, rounded clipping, rim lighting, shadow, controls and text separately. Return the finished bitmap asset.
landscape: Use case: style-transfer. Production background atlas for the exact wellness app design supplied. Reference image: the three phone designs are the sole style, color, composition and lighting source. Generate one PORTRAIT bitmap, 1024 x 1536, divided into exactly THREE equal horizontal panels edge-to-edge, NO gutters, NO dividing lines. Each panel is a 1024x512 (2:1 landscape) text-free app header background. TOP panel: faithfully reproduce the left PMS phone's dark wine/rose/mauve sky, flowing satin dunes, glowing pale peach CRESCENT moon at x76%,y34%, rose sunset glow along the distant dunes. MIDDLE panel: reproduce the middle cramps phone's dark reddish copper sky, warm rust/amber silky dunes, luminous pale apricot CRESCENT moon at x76%,y34%, orange glow close to the horizon. BOTTOM panel: reproduce the right fatigue phone's indigo/lavender sky and silky lavender hills, silver lilac CRESCENT moon at x76%,y34%, plus a narrow calm LAKE in the lower quarter with subtle horizontal moonlight reflections exactly as the reference. All three moons must be THIN CRESCENTS opening to the upper-right, NEVER full suns or circles. Faithfully match the reference's satin hill texture and light, not a new style. Top-left regions remain darker clear sky to hold native labels later. Each scene has spacious dark sky in upper half, dune horizon around y60%, darker softly detailed foreground lower third. Low-noise premium 2D illustrated material realism, soft luminous light, no extra stars or conspicuous particles. No UI, lettering, text, buttons, icons, people, phones, devices, frames, page titles or borders. Preserve panel order. The application overlays all live UI separately. Return only this clean three-row background atlas.
photo: Use case: style-transfer. Production food photograph for a 2D wellness application. The supplied reference board's three food cards show the SAME chickpea and bulgur bowl; use that bowl photograph as the sole visual reference. Generate one wide 1536x768 image, no UI. Faithfully match the appetizing slightly low three-quarter camera angle, rounded matte warm ceramic bowl, vivid whole golden chickpeas in the lower front, fluffy cooked bulgur upper back, bright cherry tomato halves, fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves, tiny glints of olive oil, and warm dimensional side lighting in the reference. Bowl centered around x77%,y55%, filling the RIGHT two-thirds; rightmost rim can be gently cropped at the image edge, food mound and curved front bowl must remain visible. LEFT third contains softly blurred warm brown table/linen and creamy defocused light to accommodate native text later; no dominant ingredient shapes there. Strong natural warm side light from upper left, glowing highlights on chickpeas, realistic contact shadow under bowl, shallow depth of field, rich natural greens and reds. This must feel like the reference, not a flat overhead plate, not a mixed chopped salad. No words, no labels, no icons, no buttons, no numbers, no hands, no phone, no graphic border or watermark. Ingredients limited to the reference bowl. Return only the finished wide photo.
